hook.name: SwapPointsHook
hook.description: Points rewards hook for swappers: charges a fixed 0.01% fee on the swapper's output token and sends it to the treasury, and mints points equal to 1% of the token0 amount to the swapper. Any residual token left on the hook is returned to the swapper in the same swap, and the pool price is recorded on every swap for external use. Treasury and points token are immutable, the hook never holds funds, and nested afterSwap calls are blocked by a reentrancy guard.
